_meta.trust_law: Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 (NSW); PSA Regulation 2022

max_interest_rate_pa.notes: Simple interest on overdue levies: 10% per annum (SSMA s.85).

max_interest_rate_pa_by_special_resoluti.notes: NSW does not permit a higher rate by special resolution — 10% is the ceiling.

interest_grace_period_days.notes: One-month grace period before interest accrues on overdue levies.

can_transfer_between_funds.notes: Inter-fund transfers permitted with 3-month notice of motion at general meeting.

inter_fund_transfer_resolution_required.notes: General meeting resolution required; 3-month notice of motion. Allowed values: none, ordinary, general_meeting, special, prohibited.

overbudget_threshold_pct.notes: Invoices that would push a budget line more than 10% over cap require general meeting approval.

overbudget_requires_resolution_above_pct.notes: General meeting resolution required for any spend exceeding the approved budget line by more than 10%.

trust_withdrawal_authority_roles.notes: Only a Class 1 Licensee-in-Charge may authorise trust withdrawals per PSA Regulation 2022.

trial_balance_deadline_days.legislation: Property and Stock Agents Regulation 2022 (NSW) reg 30
trial_balance_deadline_days.notes: Trial balance must be prepared within 21 days after month-end.

audit_deadline.notes: Trust account audit must be completed by 30 September each year.

pooled_trust_permitted.notes: Pooled trust accounts are permitted as the default arrangement.

interest_belongs_to.notes: Interest on pooled trust accounts must be paid into a statutory interest account (s.90), not distributed to the scheme. Allowed values: scheme, statutory_account, body_corporate.

committee_spending_cap_formula.notes: NSW does not impose a per-lot committee spending cap formula.

min_withholding_pct_no_abn.notes: ATO PAYG withholding: 47% on payments to suppliers without ABN.

agm_notice_days.notes: Minimum 7 clear days notice for general meetings.

strata_hub_report_months.notes: Annual report to Strata Hub due within 3 months of AGM.

agent_report_frequency_months.notes: Strata managing agent must report every 6 months to OC.

levy_notice_hardship_required.notes: Levy notices must include Financial Hardship Information Statement.

capital_works_fund_plan_years.notes: Capital works fund plan must cover at least 10 years.

capital_works_fund_plan_deadline.notes: Standard form capital works fund plan required by April 2026.

insurance_quotes_minimum.notes: Agent must obtain at least 3 quotes per insurance type; written reasons if fewer.

insurance_commission_disclosure_required.notes: Insurance quotation must itemise commissions, broker fees, taxes.

evoting_notice_days.notes: Electronic ballot must be accessible at least 7 days before meeting.

levy_interest_rate_default_percent.notes: Default simple interest on unpaid levies: 10% per annum.

levy_interest_rate_max_percent.notes: NSW ceiling is 10% — no higher rate by special resolution.

levy_interest_rate_min_percent.notes: OC may resolve a lower rate.

audit_threshold_budget_aud.notes: Mandatory audit trigger — consult scheme's by-laws and PSAA.

audit_threshold_lots.notes: Schemes with 100+ lots have enhanced reporting obligations.

record_inspection_days.notes: Records must be made available for inspection within 10 days of request.

public_liability_minimum_aud.notes: Minimum $20M public liability insurance for NSW schemes.

building_insurance_required.notes: Building insurance at replacement value — mandatory.

sinking_fund_review_years.notes: Capital works fund plan must be reviewed every 10 years.

manager_contract_max_years.notes: Strata management contracts may not exceed 3 years.

agm_notice_period_days.notes: Minimum 7 clear days notice required for all general meetings (AGMs and EGMs).

proxy_cap_scheme_pct.notes: No single person may hold proxies representing more than 5% of lots in a scheme of 20+ lots.

proxy_cap_small_scheme_lots.notes: In schemes of fewer than 20 lots, a person may hold at most 1 proxy.

proxy_cap_scheme_size_threshold.notes: Threshold below which the 1-proxy cap applies; at or above, 5% scheme cap applies.

building_manager_duties_register_require.notes: Strata managing agent must maintain a register of duties delegated to building managers. Penalty: up to $5,500.

building_manager_duties_register_penalty.notes: Penalty for failing to maintain building manager duties register.

initial_maintenance_schedule_required.notes: Owners corporation must prepare and maintain an initial maintenance schedule for common property.

initial_maintenance_schedule_deadline_mo.notes: If the developer did not provide the IMS, the OC must prepare one within 6 months of plan registration.

initial_maintenance_schedule_review_freq.notes: The IMS must be reviewed at each AGM.

manager_report_period_months.notes: Strata managing agent must provide the OC with a financial report every 6 months.

manager_report_retention_years.notes: 6-monthly manager reports must be retained for at least 10 years.

evoting_permitted.notes: Electronic voting is permitted for strata scheme general meetings in NSW from November 2022.

evoting_platform_must_be_approved.notes: NSW does not require use of an approved platform; any electronic method acceptable.

privacy_dsar_response_days.notes: Response to Data Subject Access Request must be provided within 30 days under APP 12.

capital_funding_standard_notice_days.legislation: SSMA 2015 s.83; NSW Government levy guidance
capital_funding_standard_notice_days.notes: Standard contribution notices generally require at least 30 days before payment is due.

capital_funding_emergency_notice_days.legislation: SSMA 2015 s.83; NSW Government emergency repair levy guidance
capital_funding_emergency_notice_days.notes: Emergency repair levy notices may use a 14-day payment period when the statutory criteria are met.

capital_funding_notice_period_verified.notes: Standard and emergency levy payment periods are encoded from NSW legislation and official guidance.

capital_funding_resolution_required.notes: Annual and special levies are set by owners corporation resolution at a general meeting.

capital_funding_allocation_basis.notes: Contributions are levied in proportion to each lot's unit entitlement unless a specific statutory exception applies.

capital_funding_benefit_principle_availa.notes: Default NSW contribution allocation is unit entitlement; mixed-use exceptions require legal review and approved resolution text.

capital_funding_tenant_consultation_requ.notes: Tenant notice is not a default levy-approval condition; works access and by-law impacts must be handled separately.

capital_funding_hardship_notice_required.legislation: SSMA 2015 s.79; NSW Government hardship guidance
capital_funding_hardship_notice_required.notes: Special levy workflows should include financial hardship information and payment-plan channels.

capital_funding_hybrid_legal_review_requ.notes: Hybrid owner-funded and loan-funded structures require recorded legal approval before notices or credits are issued.
